findings.title: Floating WPM canvas never opts into native mouse event delivery
findings.reproduction: Enable floating WPM, type, attempt a compact or graph drag. Actual owner emits no element tracking flags or canvasMouseEvents; faithful native admission delivers zero callbacks, leaving the frame unchanged. Explicit native opt-in positive control delivers three callbacks and moves the same owner +90,+90.
findings.root_cause: wpm_widget installs mouseCallback without native trackMouseDown/Up/Move or canvasMouseEvents; Hammerspoon 1.1.1 defaults all false and mouseCallback setter only disables ignoresMouseEvents.
findings.silent_failure: No callback is dispatched and no exception occurs. Runtime start succeeds, so native acquisition compensation cannot detect the absent interaction. Reset position only restores a default.
findings.regression_test: Exercise actual widget through native-default event admission, not direct callback invocation; require compact and graph movement/persistence and retained callback fencing after stop.

findings.title: WPM default anchor remains outside the desktop after display shrink
findings.reproduction: With no stored anchor start at 1600x1000, type to allocate default x1515,y927; shrink available desktop to800x600 and tick again. Actual owner keeps requesting x1515,y927 without diagnostics; Reset changes requested geometry to715,527.
findings.root_cause: wpm_widget queries current screen but initializes _pos_x/_pos_y only when nil; display topology changes never invalidate or validate cached anchors. Hammerspoon forwards the requested frame to borderless NSWindow; AppKit documented constrainFrameRect leaves horizontal position unaffected.
findings.silent_failure: Runtime remains running and draw succeeds at requested offscreen coordinates. Reset is an explicit recovery backstop; no automatic visibility or topology check exists. Actual compositor hotplug was not executed.
findings.regression_test: Start with default anchor, replace desktop geometry, and require next draw to intersect a current display while respecting intentional multi-monitor placement. Include native Darwin validation.
